# Task P2-07: Naming template engine

**Phase:** 2 · **Depends on:** P2-00 · **Suggested tier:** cheap worker · **Estimated size:** M

## Goal
Render a library's naming template (Lidarr's `{Token}` syntax) into the relative path of an imported file, safely: illegal characters replaced the Lidarr way, per-segment trimming, a 255-byte cap per segment, optional groups, casing/separator variants and validation with messages a user can act on. Pure code; the import pipeline (P2-13) and the naming preview API (P2-14) call it.

## Deliverables
Namespace `Wondarr.Core.Organizer`.

1. `src/Wondarr.Core/Organizer/NamingValues.cs` — `public sealed record NamingValues` (init properties, all nullable unless noted): `ArtistName` (required), `AlbumArtistName`, `AlbumTitle`, `AlbumType`, `ReleaseYear` (int?), `OriginalYear` (int?), `TrackTitle` (required), `TrackArtistName`, `TrackNo` (int?), `DiscNo` (int?), `DiscCount` (int?), `ArtistMbId`, `AlbumMbId`, `RecordingMbId`, `ReleaseMbId`, `Isrc`, `QualityTitle`, `QualityFull`, `AudioCodec`, `AudioBitRate` (int? kbps), `AudioSampleRate` (int? Hz), `AudioBitsPerSample` (int?), `Source`, `Version`. Plus `public sealed record NamingOptions(bool AsciiFold = false, string Extension = "mp3")`.
2. `src/Wondarr.Core/Organizer/NamingTemplate.cs` — `public static class NamingTemplate`:
   - `NamingValidationResult Validate(string template)` → `(bool IsValid, IReadOnlyList<string> Errors)`.
   - `string Render(string template, NamingValues values, NamingOptions? options = null)` → relative path with `/` separators, **without** the extension. Throws `ArgumentException` with the first validation error for an invalid template.

4. `tests/Wondarr.Core.Tests/Organizer/NamingTemplateTests.cs` — facts: every preset validates; `Render` never returns a segment that is empty, `.` or `..`, starts with `.`, or ends with `.` or a space (fuzz a few hundred random titles made of `abc .:/\?*"<>|`-characters with a fixed `Random` seed); a value containing `/` never adds a path level.

## Rules (LIBRARY_OUTPUT §7.1; the golden file is authoritative)
- **Tokens** (inside `{…}`; names case-insensitive for lookup): `Artist Name`, `Artist CleanName`, `Artist NameThe`, `Artist NameFirstCharacter`, `Artist MbId`, `Album Artist Name`, `Album Title`, `Album CleanTitle`, `Album Type`, `Album MbId`, `Release Year`, `Original Year`, `Track Title`, `Track CleanTitle`, `Track ArtistName`, `Recording MbId`, `Release MbId`, `ISRC`, `Quality Full`, `Quality Title`, `MediaInfo AudioCodec`, `MediaInfo AudioBitRate` (`"1025 kbps"`), `MediaInfo AudioSampleRate` (`"44.1 kHz"` — kHz with up to one decimal, invariant culture), `MediaInfo AudioBitsPerSample` (`"16bit"`), `Source`, `Version`, and the numeric tokens `track:<fmt>` / `medium:<fmt>` where `<fmt>` is a zero-pad pattern (`0`, `00`, `000`).
- **Variants:** the separator used between a token's words (`Artist Name`, `Artist.Name`, `Artist_Name`, `Artist-Name`) is also used to replace the spaces in the rendered value; the casing of the token decides the casing of the value: all lower-case → value lower-cased, all upper-case → upper-cased, otherwise as-is (Lidarr's rule).
- **Modifiers:** `{Album Title:10}` truncates to the first 10 characters (then trims), no ellipsis.
- **`medium`** renders empty when `DiscCount` is null or ≤ 1 (so single-disc albums get `08 - …`, multi-disc `203 - …`). `track` renders empty when `TrackNo` is null.
- **NameThe:** a leading `The `, `A ` or `An ` (case-insensitive) moves to the end after a comma (`Beatles, The`). **NameFirstCharacter:** the first character of the NameThe form, upper-cased (`B`). **CleanName / CleanTitle:** `&` → `and`, `/` and `\` → space, then remove every character that is not a letter, digit, space or `-`, collapse whitespace.
- **Optional groups:** `[` … `]` in the template is an optional group: rendered without the brackets when every token inside is non-empty, removed entirely when any token inside is empty. Literal brackets are written `[[` and `]]`. Groups do not nest.
- **Empty tokens outside groups** render empty; afterwards remove empty `()` and `[]` pairs together with one preceding space, collapse runs of spaces, and remove a dangling ` - ` at the start or end of a segment.
- **Illegal characters** are replaced in each **token value** before it is inserted (so a `/` in a value never creates a folder), with Lidarr's `FileNameBuilder.CleanFileName` map: `\` → `+`, `/` → `+`, `<` → ``, `>` → ``, `?` → `!`, `*` → `-`, `|` → ``, `"` → ``, and `:` — `": "` → `" - "`, other `:` → `-`. Port the method from `.worker/ref/Lidarr/src/NzbDrone.Core/Organizer/FileNameBuilder.cs` (GPL-3.0) **with an attribution header** (`// Ported from Lidarr (https://github.com/Lidarr/Lidarr), src/NzbDrone.Core/Organizer/FileNameBuilder.cs, GPL-3.0`) — that header makes `scripts/check-notice.py` require a `NOTICE.md` entry, which the orchestrator adds; list it in your done-report.
- **Per segment** (split the rendered template on `/`): trim spaces, remove leading dots, remove trailing dots and spaces; the **last** segment is capped at `255 − (1 + extension length)` UTF-8 bytes, other segments at 255 bytes, cutting only at character boundaries (never split a surrogate pair or a multi-byte UTF-8 sequence), then re-trimmed.
- **ASCII folding** (`AsciiFold`): apply the existing `TextFolding.RemoveDiacritics` (`src/Wondarr.Core/Metadata/TextFolding.cs`) to each value — **not** `string.Normalize`, which `InvariantGlobalization` turns into a no-op for non-ASCII.
- **Validation errors:** unknown token → `Unknown token {Nope}`; unbalanced braces → `Unbalanced '{'` / `Unbalanced '}'`; a template starting with `/` or `\`, or containing a drive letter → `Template must be relative`; a segment that is exactly `..` or `.` → `Template must not contain '..' or '.' segments`; the last segment has none of the `Track Title`/`Track CleanTitle` variants → `The file name must contain {Track Title}`; empty template → `Template is empty`.
